_doc: Today's energy from recorder/statistics_during_period (eink-ha-os#308): cases = hourlyStatistics(stats, metersOf(prefs), now, tz) (emulator src/core/energyHourly.ts = firmware EntityAdapter::setHourlyStatistics after setEnergyPrefs, setNow(now/1000)); out = logical id → state kWh and `today` (24 × kWh) for the hourly series. rolls = statsDayRoll after an answer to `stats` at answeredAt (firmware EntityAdapter::rollDay after setNow(now/1000)): roll = ask the recorder again now, out = what the roll emits (every id the answer fed, at 0).

cases.name: today-only
cases.description: Rows from yesterday evening are dropped; hours 0–9 fill, the rest stay 0.

cases.name: late-answer-after-midnight
cases.description: A request sent at 23:59 answered at 00:00:20 carries only yesterday: every total and bar is 0.

cases.name: empty-answer
cases.description: HA omits ids without rows (right after midnight): nothing is emitted.

cases.name: india-midnight
cases.description: Local midnight is not UTC midnight: IST 00:00 = 18:30 UTC.

rolls.name: midnight
rolls.description: 23:00 answer, 00:00:05 now: roll, everything 0, ask again.

rolls.name: utc-midnight-not-local
rolls.description: 00:30 CET answer (23:30 UTC the day before), 01:10 CET now: same local day, no roll.

rolls.name: never-answered
rolls.description: No statistics answer yet: nothing to roll.

rolls.name: india-midnight
rolls.description: 23:30 IST answer, 00:01 IST now (same UTC day): roll.
